scope: Supplied installer and its extracted regular-file payload only; no execution, user databases, live audio, credentials or service calls

derivedArm64.method: system lipo -thin arm64; byte equality to original slice independently checked

observations.observation: Shipped names and serialized-key literals describe a rich context schema; names alone do not show which fields are populated or transmitted.
Separate scene and enhanced/baseline result structures exist; no server model or prompt is established.
Selectors identify SSE dispatch and distinct packet/control handlers; call order and active mode require native function analysis.
Packaged database schema contains encrypted-named LLM configuration/result columns and an audio path. No user database was opened; this does not prove active history settings or encryption strength.
Cross-process speech and retry names separate ASR and LLM configuration; this is a static protocol surface.

The preference app presents four usage scenes (email polish, work-message reply, vibe-coding prompt, all-scene AI typing) and states that enabled Skills are chosen per input scene. Product copy is not evidence of server behavior.

observations.observation: In the full arm64 __text disassembly no call site sends setScreenContent:, setSceneContext:, setMemory: or setChatHistory:. setClipboard: is called by the context fast-fields builder and the ASR params builder. Indirect writes (KVC, dynamic selectors) are not excluded.
observations.searchBoundary: llvm-objdump --macho symbolized stub targets _objc_msgSend$<selector> in Chatterfly arm64 slice

limitations: CF identifiers are local observations, not REA Evidence IDs.

REA analyze_function hit provider_timeout at 1200000 ms before returning any native dossier. Queued native requests were cancelled. Focused instruction analysis is ordinary static evidence, not successful REA decompilation.
String/schema presence does not establish active settings, request transmission, model/provider identity, prompt or runtime latency.
Extracted regular files do not materialize archive symlinks; binaries were not executed.

instructionAnalysis.tool: Apple LLVM llvm-objdump 21.0.0 Mach-O disassembler; system nm symbol boundaries
instructionAnalysis.validation: Selected instruction bytes matched derived arm64 file; names/constants are metadata observations. Branch/dataflow conclusions are analyst static inferences, not target execution.

functions.observation: Builds dictionary with request_id, asr_text, session_id, enable_pause_detect, vp_trigger; conditionally includes uid/debug, audit_only from shortUtterance, context from contextDict or Context.toDict, ext_config and guide_ctx. This is client serialization, not observed transmission or a recovered server prompt.

Queries IsSecureEventInputEnabled, sets isPassword, and returns early on that branch before clipboard/text acquisition. Other path obtains clipboard text, before-cursor text bounded to 200 units and an AX snapshot requested with maxLength 200. Selection-cache use depends on AX confirmed-no-selection versus unavailable. Static control flow does not establish actual authorization or execution.

constantAnchors.reference: @"[sel-precache] consume: AX confirmed no selection, skip cache"

functions.observation: Calls fast fields and observes earlyReturn. Checks keyVoiceEnhancedRecognitionEnabled before loading cached recent records for the current app. This function does not establish screen/chat/memory acquisition.

Conditionally serializes platform, app, input_content, input_env, screen_content, clipboard, input_history, scene_context, event_id, timestamp and memory; availability is separate from actual population.

Cancels old post-process; creates processor by mode/session; attaches context, contextDict from llmConfigDict, extended settings, short-utterance policy and callbacks; passes asrStableText into processWithAsrText. Authentication providers are referenced but no values were read.
Changes processing state, cancels previous LLM tasks and calls startPostProcessWithSessionData. Numeric state values are not assigned semantic enum names.

Constructs SGEventSource with URL/headers/timeout/method/body, installs message/error/ready-state handlers and timeout, sets reconnect policy and calls open. Traffic and reachability were not observed.
After optional frame decryption and JSON/type checks, reads seq/finish/delta and dispatches cmode/error/scene/step_info/skill/guide/pause/perf.
Parses a finished scene packet into route/reason/path/confidence/label on pending-response step-info. No local scene-model inference is established here.

Accumulates deltas and invokes onDelta for nonfinal packets. Finished data stores text or accumulated deltas plus tips/raw_tail on pending response. This does not prove inference on each ASR revision.

Stores LLM response, branches on errors/result codes, obtains response data.text as enhancedText, calls history helper and commitFinalSpeechText. Delivery-helper host strategy is outside this bounded analysis.
Mode equal to 1 selects SGSpeechPostProcessorSSE, otherwise SGSpeechPostProcessor. Both ship; active mode was not observed.
Conditionally serializes before_cursor, after_cursor and selected_text.
Serializes type only (corrected: is_password is not serialized; see CF-asm-sel-input-env-dict).
Maps AX subrole AXSearchField to "search" and role AXTextField or AXTextArea to "text"; any other role yields an empty type.
Serializes only key "type" when non-empty. The isPassword flag is not serialized here and the string is_password does not occur in the binary; it gates the context builder locally.
Takes NSWorkspace frontmostApplication; display_name is the frontmost window title when available, otherwise localizedName; also stores bundleIdentifier.

CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo(0x11) on-screen windows; selects the first window whose kCGWindowOwnerPID equals the app pid, kCGWindowLayer is 0 and kCGWindowName is non-empty. On current macOS window names require Screen Recording permission; without it the app name is used.
Serializes display_name and bundle_id when non-empty. In a browser the window title is normally the page title.
Creates the context with platform "macos", the current app info and a timestamp.

Parses scene {route, reason, path, confidence, label}, cmode {reasoning, baseline_output, enhanced_output, tips}, fallback {kind, message, asr_text, cmode_error} and latency {e2e_ms, scene_ms, cmode_ms}: scene selection and rewriting are separately timed server stages.
Copies the response scene path onto the voice-edit segment with skill id, finish method and AX anchors, so later user edits are attributed to the scene; it does not change delivered text.
Reports the scene path as telemetry key scene_path.

Typing-IME heuristic: per-browser tables (bundle IDs of Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Edge, QQ and 360 browsers) and caret geometry relative to the frontmost window bounds from CGWindowList decide whether the caret is in the address bar. No URL is read.
Typing-IME heuristic: matches browser window titles from CGWindowList (split on "-") to detect one site. Page identity comes from the window title, not a URL.
Pingback field llqScene (browser sub-scene) is set to constant 0 on this commit path; the llq_* category labels are dormant telemetry in this build.
